  template: _publications.ejs
  sort: "year desc"
  categories: unnumbered
  filter-ui: [title, authors, venue, year, categories]
  sort-ui: false
  fields: [title, authors, venue, year, categories, url, pdf]
  page-size: 100
---

100+ publications, including 4 books and 13 book chapters, with Brill, Benjamins, Language Science Press, Oxford University Press and Springer. Filter them by type and topic; [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7631-5063) and [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=zdhKTgEAAAAJ&hl=en) have the complete record.

::: {#pub-chips .pub-chips}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Types get their own row of chips; every other category is a topic.
var PUB_TYPES = ["Journal article", "Conference paper", "Book chapter", "Book", "Preprint", "Report", "Dataset", "Patent"];

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var box = document.getElementById("pub-chips");
  var src = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category .category");
  if (!box || !src.length) return;
  var names = Array.prototype.map.call(src, function (el) { return el.textContent; });
  var types = PUB_TYPES.filter(function (t) { return names.indexOf(t) >= 0; });
  var topics = names.filter(function (n) { return PUB_TYPES.indexOf(n) < 0; });
  var active = { type: "", topic: "" };

  function apply() {
    var lists = window["quarto-listings"] || {};
    Object.keys(lists).forEach(function (id) {
      var list = lists[id];
      if (!list) return;
      if (!active.type && !active.topic) { list.filter(); return; }
      list.filter(function (item) {
        var v = item.values().categories;
        var cats = v ? decodeURIComponent(atob(v)).split(",") : [];
        return (!active.type || cats.indexOf(active.type) >= 0) &&
               (!active.topic || cats.indexOf(active.topic) >= 0);
      });
    });
  }

  function row(label, key, values) {
    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "pub-chip-row";
    wrap.setAttribute("role", "group");
    wrap.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter by " + label.toLowerCase());
    var lab = document.createElement("span");
    lab.className = "pub-chip-label";
    lab.textContent = label;
    wrap.appendChild(lab);
    var buttons = [];
    ["All"].concat(values).forEach(function (v) {
      var val = v === "All" ? "" : v;
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.textContent = v;
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", val === "" ? "true" : "false");
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        active[key] = val;
        buttons.forEach(function (o) { o.setAttribute("aria-pressed", o === b ? "true" : "false"); });
        apply();
      });
      buttons.push(b);
      wrap.appendChild(b);
    });
    box.appendChild(wrap);
  }

  row("Type", "type", types);
  row("Topic", "topic", topics);
  document.body.classList.add("has-pub-chips");
  // Wide screens: chips and search sit in the right column. Phones keep them above the list.
  var side = document.getElementById("quarto-margin-sidebar");
  var search = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-filter");
  if (side && window.matchMedia("(min-width: 992px)").matches) {
    if (search) box.insertBefore(search, box.firstChild);
    side.insertBefore(box, side.firstChild);
    document.body.classList.add("pub-chips-side");
  } else {
    // Phones: tuck the chip rows behind one button so the list starts sooner.
    var det = document.createElement("details");
    det.className = "pub-chips-toggle";
    var sum = document.createElement("summary");
    sum.textContent = "Filter by type and topic";
    det.appendChild(sum);
    Array.prototype.slice.call(box.querySelectorAll(".pub-chip-row")).forEach(function (r) { det.appendChild(r); });
    box.appendChild(det);
    box.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var picked = Array.prototype.filter.call(box.querySelectorAll(".pub-chip-row"), function (r) {
        return r.querySelector("button").getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true";
      }).length;
      sum.textContent = "Filter by type and topic" + (picked ? " (" + picked + " on)" : "");
    });
  }
  // A link like publications.html#low-resource-speech opens with that topic selected.
  var want = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)).toLowerCase();
  if (want) {
    var slug = function (t) { return t.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, ""); };
    box.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b) { if (slug(b.textContent) === want) b.click(); });
  }
});
</script>
```
